abort_condition: Abort on any non-finite parameter, validation logit, GAUC, nDCG@5, or primary score, or if wall-clock runtime exceeds 60 seconds; otherwise stop after 40 epochs or four validation epochs without improvement.
acceptance: Accept only if the existing validation split yields primary >= 0.6034695167541504 (champion 0.6014695167541504 plus epsilon 0.002), with finite GAUC and nDCG@5 reported. Do not inspect or tune against hidden-test data.
change_summary: Train one seed-0 FM with positive_weight=2.0 instead of 1.0. Keep k=16, lr=0.001, epochs=40, batch_size=8192, patience=4, and all other baseline behavior fixed.
hypothesis: Changing only the positive-example logistic-loss weight from 1.0 to 2.0 will increase validation primary score by at least 0.002 by giving long_view positives greater influence on the learned FM ranking.
rationale: A moderate weight of 2.0 directly strengthens positive gradients without increasing model size or requiring multiple training runs. It is a low-cost, falsifiable test: uniform reweighting may improve positive-item separation, but it can also leave ranking unchanged or reduce GAUC, so both GAUC and nDCG@5 must be measured on the existing validation split.
title: Double positive-example weight in the NumPy FM loss
